## Report text: test results and coverage

Testing was performed on November 16, 2026. Max's eight assigned black-box tests, BB-18–BB-25, cover the default group balance screen, tab navigation, settlement direction, rejection of zero and above-debt repayments, empty history search results, month validation, and screen state after recreation. All eight passed on an Android 10 / API 29 emulator. The complete available Espresso suite passed 17 tests with no failures, errors, or skipped tests. These tests use a dedicated account and a three-member Espresso group with one $30 expense split equally, leaving the test account owing $10.

The eight assigned white-box cases, WB-18–WB-25, already existed in `F4BalanceAndSettlementTest` and `F5HistoryAndSummaryTest`. They were reviewed, and two were extended: WB-21 now checks that editing a repayment can use the full original debt limit and that an excessive edit leaves the saved payment unchanged; WB-24 now checks that combined history filters use AND semantics. The full local JUnit suite passed all 74 tests, with no failures, errors, or skips.

JaCoCo 0.8.12 measured coverage across the entire `com.splitsmart.app.business` package, including nested classes, using the full team's local JUnit suite. UI, model, and persistence classes were excluded from this coverage denominator. The percentages therefore describe the team's existing and extended unit tests together, not Max's eight cases alone. Executable-line coverage is used as a proxy for statement coverage; JaCoCo does not report a literal count of Java statements.

| Coverage scope | Executable-line coverage | Branch coverage |
|---|---:|---:|
| Entire business package | 523/819 (63.86%) | 197/411 (47.93%) |
| BalanceManager | 81/88 (92.05%) | 33/42 (78.57%) |
| SettlementManager | 43/50 (86.00%) | 13/20 (65.00%) |
| HistoryManager | 43/51 (84.31%) | 30/34 (88.24%) |

Coverage is strongest on the assigned balance and history logic. Remaining gaps include untested FriendManager and ActivityManager code and partially covered requests, group invitations, account error handling, and summary paths. Passing tests do not establish that every behavior is correct. The in-memory white-box tests also do not verify deployed Firebase security rules, and the Espresso results establish execution on API 29 rather than on every supported Android version.

# Technical reference and test-ID mapping

## Run the tests

Use JDK 21 and an API 26+ emulator. In Android Studio, sync Gradle after pulling.

- All local JUnit tests and business coverage: `./gradlew :app:businessCoverageReport`
- All Espresso tests: `python3 scripts/run_espresso_tests.py`
- Only Max's screen tests:
  `python3 scripts/run_espresso_tests.py --classes com.splitsmart.app.GroupWorkspaceTest,com.splitsmart.app.SettlementFormTest,com.splitsmart.app.HistoryTest,com.splitsmart.app.SummaryTest,com.splitsmart.app.HomeTest`

The Python launcher reads `.gradle/espresso-test-credentials.json`, which is ignored by Git.
The file contains `{"accounts":{"primary":{"email":"espresso.test@usc.edu","password":"..."}}}`.
It passes credentials through a temporary Gradle initialization script, without embedding the
password in command-line arguments, source code or the APK. Obtain the shared fixture password
privately; do not commit the local file. Android Studio can instead use `testEmail` and
`testPassword` instrumentation arguments as described in the project README.

## Required fixture

Use only the dedicated test account, not a developer's real account. Max's tests fail with a
setup message if its credentials are missing rather than silently skipping or using a personal account.

- Account: `espresso.test@usc.edu`, display name Espresso Test.
- Group: **Espresso**, with Espresso Test, Espresso Alice and Espresso Bob.
- One expense: **Espresso test dinner**, $30, category Food, dated in the emulator's current month.
- Alice paid; each of the three members has a $10 equal share.
- No settlements. Espresso Test owes Alice $10 and is owed $0.

The eight screen tests do not create valid payments or change this fixture. They reject invalid
payments and verify the original $10 balance afterwards. AJ's group-creation test creates its own
uniquely named group and deletes that group on completion. Run the shared fixture tests serially;
parallel team runs against a changing fixture can invalidate the expected amounts/counts. If the
month changes, prepare a fresh current-month fixture before the summary test.

## Black-box tests

All eight use the real app UI and live Firebase data, extend `EspressoTestBase` through
`SeededEspressoTestBase`, and launch Home with `ActivityScenarioRule`. `UiUtils.IDLING` waits for
background work; there are no fixed sleeps. The session rule signs in before Home is launched.

| ID | Class and method | Input / action | Expected result / rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| BB-18 | GroupWorkspaceTest.opensOnBalances | Open Espresso | Balances selected; both balance labels visible; $10 payable and $0 receivable. Default-destination use case. |
| BB-19 | GroupWorkspaceTest.tabsSwitchContent | History → Summary → Balances | Active tab changes; search, year/month, then balances appear. Navigation coverage. |
| BB-20 | SettlementFormTest.directionToggleChangesLabel | Record Settlement → I was paid → I paid | Label changes Paid to → Received from → Paid to; selected direction follows. Requirement check. |
| BB-21 | SettlementFormTest.zeroAmountRejected | Enter 0 and Save | Form and typed amount remain; back navigation shows original $10 debt. Lower boundary. |
| BB-22 | SettlementFormTest.aboveDebtRejected | Enter 999 against $10 debt and Save | Form remains and debt stays $10. Invalid amount above the debt limit. |
| BB-23 | HistoryTest.noMatchShowsEmptyState | Search zzzz, then clear search | Empty message and zero rows; clearing restores the seeded expense. Invalid search class and recovery. |
| BB-24 | SummaryTest.monthRange | Enter month 13, then the current month | Invalid input leaves last valid summary intact; valid input shows one expense and $30 total. Month boundary and recovery. |
| BB-25 | HomeTest.tabSurvivesRecreate | Activity tab → ActivityScenario.recreate() | Activity remains selected with its panel and heading visible. State preservation. |

The month test observes that invalid input preserves the previous displayed result, rather than
matching Toast text, which is not portable across Android versions. Other server/UI errors can
also leave a screen in place, so the setup precondition and successful baseline reads matter.

## White-box review

These methods already existed in F4BalanceAndSettlementTest and F5HistoryAndSummaryTest.
The local fake backend isolates calculation tests from Firebase and resets state per test instance.
They exercise real managers with in-memory repositories. They do not verify deployed Firestore rules.

| ID | Existing method | Logic checked |
|---|---|---|
| WB-18 | F4.debtsAccumulateAndOffsetWithinAPair | Multiple debts add; opposite-direction expenses offset to $11. |
| WB-19 | F4.payableAndReceivableTotalsAreSeparate | $15 receivable and $4 payable are reported separately. |
| WB-20 | F4.debtsAreNotSimplifiedAcrossPairs | Alice→Bob and Bob→Carol do not invent Alice→Carol debt. |
| WB-21 | F4.settlementCreateEditAndDeleteUpdateBalances | Create, edit, delete recompute debt. Extended to accept an edit up to the full original $11 and reject $11.01 without changing the saved amount. |
| WB-22 | F4.settlementRejectsZeroNegativeAndAboveDebtAmounts | Reject zero, negative, excess debt and too many decimal places. |
| WB-23 | F4.recipientCanRecordASettlement | Recipient can record payment and remains its creator; debt reduces. |
| WB-24 | F5.filtersByTypeCategoryAndInvolvedMember | Type, category and member filters. Extended with combined matching/nonmatching filters to verify AND semantics. |
| WB-25 | F5.monthlySummaryCountsExpensesAndExcludesSettlements | Monthly expense count, spending and category totals exclude settlements. |

## Bug history for the testing document

These three product fixes predate this testing work; do not describe them as newly discovered here.

- **Settlement editing:** users previously could not edit a settlement. Creator-only editing was
  added. WB-21 checks balance changes and the old-payment amount being added back to the edit limit.
- **Recording received payments:** only the payer previously could record a payment. The app added
  I paid / I was paid and recipient-side permission checks. BB-20 checks the direction UI; WB-23
  checks recipient-side business logic. Deployed Firestore authorization needs separate integration testing.
- **History participants:** rows previously omitted who was involved. The app now displays payer/
  participant names. The eight assigned tests do not establish a dedicated regression test for this fix;
  document a separate manual check rather than claiming it is covered by BB-23.

## Coverage and execution evidence

JaCoCo reports executable-line, instruction and branch
coverage; executable-line coverage is the statement-coverage proxy used here, not a literal count of
Java statements. The report includes all `com.splitsmart.app.business` classes, including nested
classes. It excludes UI, model and persistence code from the denominator. It covers the entire local
JUnit suite, not only Max's eight assigned methods. Do not attribute that whole-suite coverage to Max alone.

Generated reports (ignored by Git):

- Espresso: `app/build/reports/androidTests/connected/debug/index.html`
- JUnit: `app/build/reports/tests/testDebugUnitTest/index.html`
- Coverage: `app/build/reports/jacoco/businessCoverageReport/html/index.html`

Measured on November 16, 2026 with JaCoCo 0.8.12 and the full 74-test JUnit suite.
All 74 passed (0 failures, 0 errors). Android lint also passed.

| Scope | Executable lines covered | Branches covered |
|---|---:|---:|
| Entire business package | 523/819 (63.86%) | 197/411 (47.93%) |
| BalanceManager | 81/88 (92.05%) | 33/42 (78.57%) |
| SettlementManager | 43/50 (86.00%) | 13/20 (65.00%) |
| HistoryManager | 43/51 (84.31%) | 30/34 (88.24%) |
| SummaryManager | 71/83 (85.54%) | 35/58 (60.34%) |

Instruction coverage for the whole business package: 2818/4387 (64.24%).

Coverage limitations: FriendManager and ActivityManager have no local-JUnit coverage in this report.
RequestManager, group invitation paths, account error mapping and some summary paths are also incomplete.
A passing suite and high coverage on the assigned features do not establish that the whole app is bug-free.

The baseline five RegisterTest Espresso tests passed on Tiny_Iphone_API_29 (Android 10 / API 29),
with 0 failures and 0 skipped tests. The full screen suite then passed: **17 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skipped**, including all eight Max tests (BB-18–BB-25).
